planSteps.description: Navigate to https://soncagstock.vercel.app/ and log in with the project's configured username and password (click 'Giriş Yap'), wait until the header text 'Sonçağ Stok · Dashboard' is visible
In the status select (default option 'Stokta Olanlar') choose the option 'Tükendi' and wait 2 seconds
Every visible product row shows 0 in the 'Stok' column, OR the empty state 'Ürün bulunamadı' is shown if no product is out of stock
Change the status select back to 'Stokta Olanlar' and wait 2 seconds
Every visible product row shows a 'Stok' value greater than 0
